headline: Greek Fishermen: No Matter How Many Fish We Catch, We Cannot Cover the Cost of Diesel
summary: The president of the Nea Michaniona Trawler Cooperative said fishermen cannot cover diesel costs regardless of catch volume. Fishermen are awaiting government announcements before deciding their next steps.
why: Diesel is a major operating cost for fishing fleets, so fuel prices directly affect fishing profitability and seafood supply.
